title: InvoiceDocumentSchema
description: Strict versioned schema representing parsed invoice metadata, line items, and financial totals with decimal-safe monetary strings.

document_id.description: Unique identifier of the invoice source document or image

invoice_number.description: Invoice number or billing identifier as stated on document, null if unreadable

invoice_date.description: Normalized ISO 8601 date string (YYYY-MM-DD), null if missing

supplier_name.description: Legal or trade name of the issuing vendor, null if missing

supplier_tax_id.description: Tax registration identifier (e.g. GSTIN, VAT, EIN), optional

purchase_order_number.description: Associated purchase order reference number, optional

currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. INR, USD, EUR), null if ambiguous

page_count.description: Total number of pages in the source invoice document, when known

line_items.description: Ordered collection of extracted product/service line items

DecimalString.description: Decimal-safe string representation of a numerical value to avoid binary floating-point drift

line_item_id.description: Unique identifier of the line item within the document (e.g. item-1)

description.description: Raw extracted description of the purchased good or service

unit.description: Unit of measure (e.g. PCS, KG, LTR), null if unstated

discount_amount.description: Item-level discount amount, null if none

tax_rate.description: Item-level tax percentage (e.g. '18.0' for 18%), null if unstated

tax_amount.description: Calculated or stated item tax amount, null if unstated

line_total.description: Net or gross total charged for this line item

source_page.description: Page index on which this item appears

field_confidence.description: Extractor confidence score per field (0.0 to 1.0)

missing_fields.description: List of expected fields that were absent or unreadable

validation_warnings.description: Non-blocking validation flags specific to this line item

subtotal.description: Net total before invoice-level taxes and shipping

tax_total.description: Sum of all taxes charged on the invoice

amount_paid.description: Amount already paid by customer, optional

extractor_name.description: Name of the model or algorithm (e.g. deterministic_baseline, qwen3_vl_2b)

extractor_version.description: Version or commit tag of the extractor component

extraction_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of extraction execution

provenance.description: Auditable field origin metadata mapping field name to source token/line

review_status.description: Current lifecycle state in access control / audit queue

validation_findings_count.description: Total number of deterministic validation findings attached
